product_metadata.title: Fish Netting Assorted Colors Theme Party Decoration
description: Fish netting can be used may different ways to decorate your luau or nautical party. When you unravel and fully extend it, the assorted colors fish netting opens to be approximately four feet by twelve feet. The assorted fish netting is made of thick, dyed cotton thread, so it is easy to drape or stretch it out when decorating your room in a nautical look.
